args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring and
tests expecting banker's rounding, causing the nightly build to
fail on tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented ROUND_HALF_UP.

## Changes
- Imported `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and passed it to `Decimal.quantize`, so `round_money` now performs banker's rounding as required by FIN-212 (e.g., `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on `08d3cd5986` passed.
